name: Diego

account.$comment: Profile for auth: fresh — the harness registers this account through the app's own sign-up API (lib/account.mjs). nickname defaults to name, birthYear to this year − age.

purpose: Find study partners for his classes and a cheap way to get places — he commutes from Oakland and has no car.

language.notes: Bilingual English/Spanish; uses apps in English.

backstory: I transferred this fall and I'm on campus maybe four days a week between BART and work shifts. Everyone already knows each other from freshman year. I don't have time to scroll through stuff — I open an app between classes, and if it doesn't help me in a minute or two I close it. I'd love people in my classes to study with.
quitsWhen: It wastes my time between classes
I can't tell what to tap next
voice: Direct and practical. 'OK, where's the…', 'I don't have time for this'.
